articles.title: New fuel price hikes, petrol at €2.005 per litre, a three
articles.description: Fuel price hikes are continuing in Italy as the Iran war knock-on effects continue to bite. Petrol hit a new peak Friday after Thursday's €2.002 per litre and rose to €2.005 in self-service mode on the road, the highest price in about three years. (ANSA)
